import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

assignment = re.compile(
    r"^\s*(TMP|[abcd])\s*<-\s*"
    r"(?:(\d+)|\(\s*(TMP|[abcd])\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s+100)"
    r"\s*;\s*$",
    re.MULTILINE,
)

for match in assignment.finditer(text):
    target, literal, source, increment = match.groups()
    if literal is not None:
        values[target] = int(literal)
    else:
        values[target] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % 100

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; "
    f"c ?= {values['c']}; d ?= {values['d']}; "
    f"TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
